mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate above 14.7% over the prior 3 months signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings, which drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE < 14.7 and UNRATE falls by >0.3pp over 3 months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of rising unemployment (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) below $403.9M over the prior 3 months signals weakening aggregate demand, which reduces corporate earnings and equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS < 403946 and RSAFS falls by >2% over 3 months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of declining consumption (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 92.6 over the prior 3 months signals weakening manufacturing output, which reduces earnings and equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO < 92.5919 and INDPRO falls by >1% over 3 months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of declining industrial production (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the federal funds rate above 5.0% over the prior 3 months signals a tightening monetary cycle that raises discount rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > 5.0 and FEDFUNDS rises by >0.25pp over 3 months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of rising rates (t-test p > 0.05).

failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of rising payroll employment (t-test p > 0.05).
